statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-48702 is an unbounded gzip decompression (OOM) flaw in rekor's server-side Alpine APK entry parsing at pkg/types/alpine/apk.go (Package.Unmarshal), reachable only via the rekor transparency log HTTP endpoints POST /api/v1/log/entries and POST /api/v1/log/entries/retrieve. The kyverno family images do not run a rekor transparency log server; rekor is an indirect dependency pulled via the cosign signature-verification chain. The proposed-entry APK decompression path is never invoked.

CVE-2026-48702 is an unbounded gzip decompression (OOM) flaw in rekor's server-side Alpine APK entry parsing at pkg/types/alpine/apk.go (Package.Unmarshal), reachable only through the rekor transparency log HTTP endpoints POST /api/v1/log/entries (createLogEntry) and the searchLogQuery handler, which canonicalize a proposed entry. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/rekor code directly (rekor is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa/cosign chain) and does not run a rekor transparency log, so the proposed-entry APK decompression path is never invoked.

CVE-2026-24117 is an SSRF in rekor's /api/v1/index/retrieve endpoint, which fetches a public key from a user-supplied URL. The vulnerable code is in rekor's server-side index retrieval handler. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/rekor code directly (rekor is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa/cosign chain) and does not run a rekor transparency log, so the index retrieve endpoint is never served.

CVE-2026-23831 is a nil pointer dereference in rekor's cose v0.0.1 entry Canonicalize() handler when validate() leaves sign1Msg uninitialized for an empty spec.message. The vulnerable code is in rekor's server-side proposed-entry processing. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/rekor code directly (rekor is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa/cosign chain) and does not run a rekor transparency log, so the cose entry handler is never invoked.
